[[Hearthome Gym]] }} '''Drifting Drifblim''' (Japanese: '''VS フワライド''' ''VS Drifblim''), titled '''VS Drifblim''' in the [[Chuang Yi]] translation, is the 371st chapter of the [[Pokémon Adventures]] manga, and the 34th chapter of the {{MangaArc|Diamond & Pearl}}. It is subtitled '''Conference and Kidnapping''' (Japanese: '''学会と誘拐''' ''Academic Meeting and Kidnapping'') in the [[VIZ Media]] translation and '''Academic Convention and Abduction''' in the Chuang Yi translation. ==Plot== {{spoilers}} The [[Advanced level Grunt]] develops the picture of {{adv|Platinum}}. He is curious about how Platinum had left on a journey with [[Paka and Uji|two bodyguards]] that haven't been heard of since, and how her dad seems unperturbed about the situation. He decides that now would be a good time to make his move. Meanwhile, {{adv|Diamond}}, {{adv|Pearl}}, and {{adv|Platinum}} have landed in [[Hearthome City]] after traveling on [[Fantina's Drifblim]] and are upset for how far they have backtracked. Platinum then decides that since they are there, she wants to battle the [[Gym Leader]], which [[Fantina]] accepts. After some confusion, they find out that Fantina is actually the Gym Leader of the [[Hearthome Gym]]. Then Diamond and Pearl perform a {{wp|manzai}} about on Platinum's upcoming battle with Fantina. Pearl says that they've nailed their performances, and that they should start thinking of a visual gag. Pearl goes to help Platinum with her training. After checking her [[Pokédex]], Platinum reveals that she's mostly worried about how {{p|Mismagius}} can cause hallucinations. Platinum says that she will be entering her {{TP|Platinum|Empoleon}} and {{TP|Platinum|Ponyta}}, but she's not sure how she will be able to fight the hallucinations. Pearl says to use Diamond's {{adv|Lax}}, but she wonders how Munchlax would be good against hallucinations. At the Hearthome Gym, Fantina says she will see them on the fourth floor and Platinum chooses a three Pokémon switch-in battle. Onlookers are allowed by Fantina, so all three proceed up the lifts to find their first puzzle-a math problem. Meanwhile, in [[Canalave City]] [[Professor Rowan]] is telling [[Mr. Berlitz]] that they should treat themselves for being so productive the past few days. However, Mr. Berlitz realizes he has forgotten something and goes back alone to get it. On the way he meets the Advanced level Grunt, who shows him the picture of his daughter and surrounds him with his {{p|Gible}} and {{p|Staraptor}}. The Grunt says that they have his daughter, however Mr. Berlitz does not believe this at first since he still thinks that [[Paka and Uji]] are with her. The Grunt laughs, saying that if he called them, they wouldn't pick up, since they have been disposed of. ==Major events== * {{adv|Diamond}}, {{adv|Pearl}}, and {{adv|Platinum}} find out that [[Fantina]] is the {{ci|Hearthome}} [[Gym Leader]]. * The [[Advanced level Grunt]] tricks {{adv|Platinum}}'s father into paying money by making him think they have captured Platinum. {{Adventuresevents}} {{endspoilers}} ===Debuts=== ====Pokémon debuts==== ==Characters== ===Humans=== * {{adv|Diamond}} * {{adv|Pearl}} * {{adv|Platinum}} * [[Professor Rowan]] * [[Fantina]] * [[Paka and Uji]] (fantasy) * [[Advanced level Grunt]] * [[Mr. Berlitz]] * Gym Statue ===Pokémon=== * {{p|Munchlax}} ({{adv|Lax}}; {{adv|Diamond}}'s) * {{p|Torterra}} ([[Tru]]/{{tt|Wig|Chuang Yi}}; {{adv|Diamond}}'s) * {{p|Chatot}} ([[Chatler]]/{{tt|Chahiko|Chuang Yi}}; {{adv|Pearl}}'s) * {{p|Infernape}} ([[Chimler]]/{{tt|Chimhiko|Chuang Yi}}; {{adv|Pearl}}'s) * {{p|Ponyta}} ({{OP|Platinum|Ponyta}}) * {{p|Empoleon}} ({{OP|Platinum|Empoleon}}) * {{p|Drifblim}} ({{OP|Fantina|Drifblim}}) * {{p|Mismagius}} ([[Fantina]]'s) * {{p|Duskull}} ([[Fantina]]'s; flashback) * {{p|Chingling}} ([[Advanced level Grunt]]'s) * {{p|Gible}} ([[Advanced level Grunt]]'s) * {{p|Staraptor}} ([[Advanced level Grunt]]'s) ==Trivia== ===Errors=== In one panel in the VIZ Media release, you can see the Japanese writing on Lady's headband underneath the English word "Victory".
